name: Alex Morgan
title: SEO Content Writer
tagline: I write research-backed content that ranks on Google and reads well to actual humans.
aboutParagraphs: I've spent the last four years writing content that has to do two jobs at once: rank on search engines and hold a reader's attention long enough to matter. That means every piece starts with research, not typing.

I've written for SaaS companies, travel brands, education platforms, and healthcare businesses, which means I've learned to sound like an expert in a lot of rooms I don't live in full time. That's the job: understand a topic fast, verify it against real sources, and explain it plainly.

My process covers keyword research, competitor content audits, on-page structure (headings, internal linking, meta titles and descriptions), and a final optimization pass with tools like Surfer SEO before anything goes live.
